bugs.name: Wiki Bold toolbar formatting renders as regular text in preview and saved pages
bugs.summary: The Wiki editor’s Bold toolbar inserts Markdown markers, but the sample renders in regular weight in both Preview and the saved page.
bugs.expected: Selecting text and using the Bold toolbar control should render that text visibly bold in Preview and on the saved Wiki page.
bugs.actual: The editor inserted `**Tablet formatting sample**`, but Preview and the saved page both displayed “Tablet formatting sample” in regular weight. The Markdown markers were not visible in the rendered page.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open the repository Wiki. Create a disposable page and enter Tablet formatting sample.
Select the text and click the Bold toolbar control. Confirm the editor wraps the selection in ** markers.
Open Preview and inspect the apparent font weight, then save the page through Save Page and inspect its rendered text.
bugs.reason: The user rejected the reported weak Wiki bold after reviewing the evidence. Both Preview and the saved page contain the expected strong markup, with semibold weight 600 versus paragraph weight 400. A separate saved-page browser confirmed that rendering, and a clean browser font control reproduced weak emphasis without Gitea assets. This supports a font-environment explanation rather than a Wiki formatting failure, while the exact font used by the original Mo browser remains unproven. The rejection does not rest on markup alone or on a confirmed universal font root cause.

bugs.name: Markdown Wiki links open the Pages index instead of their target
bugs.summary: Clicking a rendered Markdown link to a freshly saved Wiki page repeatedly opens the Pages index instead of the linked page.
bugs.expected: Clicking the rendered link on NAV-Q8R-Guide opens the existing NAV-Q8R-Target Wiki page.
bugs.actual: Following the agent-authored absolute Markdown URL ending /wiki/NAV-Q8R-Target opened the Pages index. The actual saved page URL and Gitea-generated link end /wiki/NAV-Q8R-Target.-; following that generated link opens the target successfully.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open the seeded eval/harbor-handbook Wiki.
Create a disposable page titled NAV-Q8R-Target with a short body and observe the generated URL ending NAV-Q8R-Target.-.
Create NAV-Q8R-Guide with an absolute Markdown link to the same fixture origin and repository, but manually end its path with /wiki/NAV-Q8R-Target, omitting the .- marker.
Follow that rendered body link; it opens the Pages index because it does not address the literal-hyphen title.
From the Pages index, follow the application-generated NAV-Q8R-Target link, whose path ends .-. Confirm the target and its saved body open successfully.
bugs.reason: User-approved rejection: the agent supplied the wrong absolute URL. Gitea uses hyphens for spaces unless the .- marker preserves literal hyphens. The report’s claimed suffix-free saved target URL is contradicted by its native trace. Markdown preserves the supplied URL; the canonical generated target link works.

matchingGuidance.scope: This rejection concerns a hand-authored absolute Markdown URL. It does not adjudicate automatic [[wiki links]] or other link-generation paths.

bugs.name: Wiki clone menu shows the main repository's Tea CLI clone command
bugs.summary: The report says that on a wiki page, the Code menu's Tea CLI tab shows the main repository's clone command instead of the wiki's.
bugs.expected: The reported expectation is that the wiki's Tea CLI clone command targets the wiki.
bugs.actual: On a wiki page, selecting Tea CLI in the Code menu was reported to show 'tea clone eval/harbor-handbook', the main repository's command.
reproSteps: Open a repository wiki page.
Open the Code menu and choose Tea CLI.
Read the full clone command in the field.
bugs.reason: The wiki's Tea CLI command is correct: it is 'tea clone <owner>/<repo>.wiki', and the HTTPS URL also ends in .wiki.git. The read-only field is only about 30 characters wide, so the command is cut off on screen right before '.wiki'; the full value (and what the copy button copies) includes it. The report read only the visible part. The main repository's menu correctly shows the command without '.wiki'.

bugs.name: Relative Markdown link to a hyphenated wiki page opens the Pages index
bugs.summary: The report says that a relative Markdown link such as [Start navigation](NAV-Start) on a wiki page opens the wiki's Pages index instead of the saved page NAV-Start.
bugs.expected: The reported expectation is that the link opens the NAV-Start page.
bugs.actual: Clicking [Start navigation](NAV-Start) on Home opened the Pages index; the NAV-Start row there opened the page at /wiki/NAV-Start.-.
reproSteps: Create a wiki page titled with a hyphen, such as NAV-Start.
On another wiki page, add the Markdown link [Start navigation](NAV-Start) and save.
Click the link.
bugs.reason: Intended: in wiki paths Gitea treats '-' as a space and marks a literal hyphen with the '.-' suffix, so a page titled NAV-Start is saved at NAV-Start.- and a link to plain NAV-Start names a page called 'NAV Start', which doesn't exist; a missing page opens the Pages index. A link to NAV-Start.-, or one generated by Gitea, opens the page. This is the same path scheme as the existing rejection 'Markdown Wiki links open the Pages index instead of their target', here with a relative link instead of an absolute URL.

bugs.name: Root-relative Markdown image displays broken image in legacy side-by-side preview
bugs.summary: The report says that a root-relative image (/avatars/…) shows as a broken image in the wiki's side-by-side preview.
bugs.expected: The reported expectation is that an image path starting with / loads from the site root, as it would on the Gitea site itself.
bugs.actual: An image written as /avatars/<hash> in a wiki page showed as broken in the preview and on the saved page; the image URL pointed into the wiki's own files and returned 404.
reproSteps: Edit a wiki page and add a Markdown image whose path starts with /, such as /avatars/<hash>.
Open the side-by-side preview, then save and view the page.
Check whether the image loads and where its URL points.
bugs.reason: Intended: a wiki image path starting with / (for example /avatars/<hash>) resolves to the wiki's own files (/<owner>/<repo>/wiki/raw/avatars/<hash>), not the site root, so it 404s. This is the same in every preview and on the saved page. Since 1.23 (go-gitea/gitea#34114), leading-slash paths are relative to the current content, so content stays portable when it's cloned, mirrored or served under a sub-path; /:root/... links to the site root, and a unit test asserts /image resolves to wiki/raw/image (models/renderhelper/repo_wiki_test.go:48). Same rule as the known-invalid 'Root-relative links in issue Markdown are prefixed with the repository path'.

bugs.name: Wiki page titled '.' is saved as 'unnamed'
bugs.summary: The report says that a wiki page saved with the title "." ends up named "unnamed".
bugs.expected: The reported expectation is that the page keeps the title ".".
bugs.actual: Saving a page titled "." created /wiki/unnamed with the content kept.
reproSteps: Create a wiki page with the title "." and some content, and save.
Check the resulting page's name and URL.
bugs.reason: Intended: "." isn't a usable file name in the wiki repository, so Gitea deliberately maps it to "unnamed", and an upstream unit test asserts that. The missing notice about the rename is a separate accepted entry; this entry covers only the claim that the title itself should have been kept.

bugs.name: Exiting an automatic list leaves following text in the last item
bugs.summary: Pressing Enter twice after a bullet removes the automatic bullet but does not create the blank line needed to end the Markdown list. The following unbulleted text joins the previous item in Preview.
bugs.expected: After exiting the automatic list, Tail paragraph should render as a separate paragraph outside the list.
bugs.actual: Preview shows two bullets: First and Second Tail paragraph. Write mode contains - First, - Second and Tail paragraph on consecutive lines without a blank separator. A whole-page assertion confirmed Tail paragraph is not a separate paragraph.
reproSteps: In the wiki Markdown editor, type - First and press Enter.
Type Second, then press Enter twice and type Tail paragraph.
Open Preview and observe Tail paragraph continuing the final list item without a separating blank line.
bugs.reason: User rejected this as normal Markdown behavior: unbulleted text immediately after a list item, without a blank separator, can continue that item. The reported Write-mode source and Preview are consistent. This rejection does not establish that every automatic-list editing interaction is correct.

matchingGuidance.scope: Covers the reported lazy list continuation with no blank line separating Tail paragraph from the final item. Excludes content loss, incorrect rendering when a proper blank separator is present, and different editor failures.

reviewEvidence.basis: Explicit user rejection as normal Markdown behavior.
limitations: Independent browser verification was not completed for this candidate.
